body.interpretation: Non-zero-guarded 64-bit increment of the script-frame field at +0x20 (FFrame::NextLocalVar): 0 stays 0, non-zero n becomes n+1. Then load the vtable pointer from [this] (RCX) and TAIL-CALL (JMP, not CALL) the virtual function at vtable byte offset 0xc70 (entry index 784). No other side effects, no return value. The reflected exec entry is only this frame side-effect plus the virtual dispatch; the real handler body lives in the vtable slot.

vtable_resolution.slot_target_meaning: The concrete AFortCreativeMoveTool implementation of PushCreativeMoveToolEquippedInputComponent. The .inc preserves the virtual dispatch (JMP [this+0xc70]) rather than inlining this target, matching the q27-11100407 HandlePullPressed precedent and keeping any derived override intact.

prologue_proof.note: The +0x20 increment prologue is byte-for-byte identical to the known-good ported AFortCreativeMoveTool::OnRep_CreativeQuickbarComponent (0x142a65bc0) and to q27-11100407 HandlePullPressed (0x1428c2e20): MOV RAX,[RDX+0x20]; XOR R8D,R8D; TEST RAX,RAX; SETNZ R8B; ADD R8,RAX; MOV [RDX+0x20],R8. This is the universal FFrame::NextLocalVar guard-increment emitted by the UE native exec wrapper.
